g.text: N28: direct relation and donor operand order
168 audited records: 24 exact original carries and 144 new continuations. Zero optimizer updates.
Two code families with dependent wordings and directions. Conditional completion, not whole-program improvement.
Foreign retention donors repeat the same paired paraphrase. Invalid source is not evidence for or against operator copying.
Identity/rescue generations, native replays, past-cache paths, scope, counters and restorations pass.
